headline: AMD Operating Profit Rises 123% on AI Demand, Shares Jump 6%
summary: AMD published its third-quarter 2026 results, showing operating profit growing 123 percent annually. Results were driven by strong chip demand and data center expansion, sending shares up 6 percent.
why: Semiconductor earnings reports serve as a primary gauge for enterprise spending on artificial intelligence and data center infrastructure.

impacts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
impacts.why: Operating profit rose 123 percent year-over-year, driven by strong AI chip demand and data center growth.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A 123% surge in operating profit and strong AI demand reassured investors and dispelled fears of a sector slowdown, driving the stock up.
